guitar.notes: Quesada favors vintage-style hollow/semi-hollow guitars; no single iconic model widely documented.

tone.target: warm soul-clean with spring room and slight edge
tone.profile: warm soul-clean with spring room and slight edge
tone.summary: A warm, compressed signal chain using a Fender-style amp model (US Deluxe) paired with a 2x12 cabinet, enhanced by light OD boost and Spring reverb for that classic soul sound.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide rounded clean attack and sustain.
Introduce light breakup and warmth without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Blues OD is used to simulate the gentle grit of a tube amp pushing into natural breakup, which is ideal for soul music.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the vintage Fender-style combo amp feel.
Match the single-coil/P90 sound and provide a tight, vintage tone.
Slightly scoop the mids and tighten the low end for clarity.
blocks.gap: Used to fine-tune the frequency response, ensuring the 'tight low end' requirement is met without muddying the warm tone.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle vintage ambience (spring reverb) as requested.
Keep delay off by default to avoid unnecessary complexity and focus on the core clean tone.
blocks.gap: The instructions specified 'drop delay', so this module is included but kept inactive/minimal.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better vintage cabinet realism and warmth.

proposals.reason: Enhance the warm, classic soul tone with more realistic vintage cabinet coloration.
